headline: Century Casinos Misses Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Century Casinos reported lower-than-expected earnings and revenue for the period, missing analysts' consensus estimates.
why: Century Casinos operates regional casinos and resorts, and its financial results provide insight into consumer discretionary spending and the health of the gaming sector.

impacts.name: Century Casinos
impacts.why: Missed earnings and revenue estimates negatively impact the company's stock valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
